chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم cursed usury, its consumer, its giver, its seller, its buyer, its recorder, and its two witnesses.

key_terms.الرِّبَا: usury; unlawful increase in a financial transaction
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.كَاتِبَهُ: the one who records the transaction
key_terms.مُؤْكِلَهُ: the one who gives or pays it

ai.seo_question: Who is condemned in a hadith about riba (usury)?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns riba in the strongest terms by invoking the curse of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم upon the practice and all those who participate in facilitating it. It shows that involvement in usurious transactions is not limited to the one who directly consumes it, but includes supporting roles connected to the transaction.
